notes.title: Zenodyne R 2025 Beta Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, Banshee here with a new update - Zenodyne R now has an updated beta branch available to anyone interested enough to try it! You can access it by using the password '[b]yesimadebackups[/b]' in the Steam Betas tab for the game, just make sure you live up to the password and backup your files first to be safe. Feedback is welcome through the usual channels and bug reports in the Troubleshooting pinned thread in the discussions forum.[/p][p][/p][p]For those who didn't see the Zenohell update from last year, this is basically part of a long-term plan to get the majority of games I was involved with running on modern GameMaker with quality-of-life fixes. I'm most of the way there with this one, but help from fresh eyes would be much appreciated. [/p][p][/p][p]Summary of changes listed below:[/p][list][*][p]GameMaker engine migration (2024.13 from GMS 1.4) means game should no longer have FPS timing issues on Windows 10/11 as well as improved controller support. Note that this makes the game also pure 64-bit[/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life features brought over from newer titles - adjustable bullet colours and wallpaper options, etc[/p][/*][*][p]Rebuilt the collision walls for stage 3 and 6-1, improving performance[/p][/*][*][p]Changed 6-1 special camera to maintain x axis with player, making death recoveries easier to handle visually[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul of techpoint handling, fixing incorrectly displayed earnings and making sure stuff saves properly at end of stage/game over[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul of Steam achievement handling and updated Steamworks DLLs[/p][/*][*][p]Overhaul of file and music operations, game no longer uses third-party external DLLs other than Steamworks[/p][/*][*][p]Moved Arcade/Expert choice menu to the Main Menu and added description text[/p][/*][*][p]Prepwork for Steam Deck support[/p][/*][*][p]Significant unseen code overhaul and miscellaneous fixes from various development time periods post-2016[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Worth noting that the save location for unlocks and highscores will change with this build - they'll still read old files from the program install folder but will write to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\\Zenodyne_Remake`, and Cloud Saves have been updated accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p]In other news, I've also started work on a Boss Rush mode to add something interesting for the 2025 update, but it isn't quite ready for the prime time yet. I'll post an update when that's ready.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Normal Mode has been added, what makes it different from old difficulty:
- Faster Score 1-ups
- Slower bullet speed
- Not having a choice to go down the harder paths

Old difficulty was made into Arcade mode. We also fixed some bugs that we spotted in testing of this patch. Previous scores are unaffected (and fall under Arcade mode)

Don't panic if the normal scores are 0s, intended behavior for pre-1.04 files you can overwrite them with new scores.

notes.title: Techpoints Rebalance Patch
notes.notes:
As it's been noted by a whole dozen of people, the game in it's early hours was clearly a bit too unforgiving and punishing TP-wise. So I decided to rebalance the TP curve a bit, offering more points early on while not messing up the curve.

Meaning you will still get most of the points later on but the point is, earlier hours should be less frustrating now.

notes.title: Pre-release Introduction Video
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yXmVM12WAYw

One of the testers, Emuser has made a video that's both an introduction to the game and the tutorial! You see the reason for this video is because it will help people understand the game better when it launches..... and because I have a demo competition planned for June 1! That's right!

THERE will be a demo scoring competition (yes the demo will be also DRM free) from June 1 9 AM GMT to June 8 9 PM GMT! The winner who posts the screenshot with the highest score gets a free copy of both Zenohell and Zenodyne R! However there will be an other reward for the participants, players who will score above 15 million in the demo, will get their name in the special hall of fame section of the game credits, in an update.

The demo will have 2 stages and the first 2 ships (which the video covers).

See you, on June 1.
